statement:
∀ (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (hp : Nat.Prime p), p ≠ 2 →
  (let det3 : ℤ × ℤ → ℤ × ℤ → ℤ × ℤ → ℤ :=
     fun P Q R => (Q.1 - P.1) * (R.2 - P.2) - (Q.2 - P.2) * (R.1 - P.1)
   let cap : ZMod p → ZMod p → ZMod p × ZMod p := fun t x => (x + t, x⁻¹)
   let lift : ZMod p → ZMod p → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℤ × ℤ :=
     fun t x i j =>
       (((cap t x).1.val : ℤ) + (i.val : ℤ) * (p : ℤ),
        ((cap t x).2.val : ℤ) + (j.val : ℤ) * (p : ℤ))
   let Mask : Type := ZMod p → Finset (Fin 2 × Fin 2)
   let points : ZMod p → Mask → Finset (ℤ × ℤ) :=
     fun t R =>
       (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : ZMod p => x ≠ 0)).biUnion
         (fun x => (R x).image (fun ij => lift t x ij.1 ij.2))
   let NoThreeCollinear : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) → Prop :=
     fun S => ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, ∀ c ∈ S, a ≠ b → a ≠ c → b ≠ c → det3 a b c ≠ 0
   ∀ (t : ZMod p) (R : Mask), NoThreeCollinear (points t R) →
     (∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun x : ZMod p => x ≠ 0), (R x).card) ≤ 3 * (p - 1))

plain_statement.zh: 对任意奇素数 p、任意平移 t 与任意每剩余 mask：若平移双曲线 cap 的 2-周期提升点无三点共线，则总点数不超过 3(p−1)。即 HJSW 的 3(p−1) 是该折叠族的上界，该族无净增。
plain_statement.en: For every odd prime p, every shift t and every mask: if the 2-period lift of the shifted hyperbola cap has no three collinear points, the total number of points is at most 3(p−1). Thus HJSW's 3(p−1) is an upper bound within this fold family, which admits no net gain.

brief.zh: 平移双曲线 cap 的 2-周期折叠族的 3(p−1) 最优性（对一切奇素数 p）。先用行列式展开与模 p 条件把纤维对约束刻画为 xx'≡±1，再证边对 S=6、约束图是 C2/C4 之并，最后用独立集/邻域计数得 Σ≤3(p−1)。
brief.en: Optimality of 3(p−1) for the 2-period fold family of the shifted hyperbola cap (all odd primes). Fibre-pair constraints are characterised by xx'≡±1 via a determinant expansion; edge pairs have S=6; the constraint graph is a union of C2/C4; an independent-set/neighbour count gives Σ≤3(p−1).
